scope: Conditional confirmation, reauthentication-adjacent, file-read and refresh waits before admission or subsequent effects
unchanged_contracts: Existing Admin/Status/Manage interaction owners and Approval Scope plans
Existing captured approval identity and removal consent
Existing request IDs and recovery generation acceptance
other_waits: Direct fetch and response-body waits reject the captured lifetime and abort owned transport
Direct awaited declarations/effects and legacy catch/finally paths recheck the lifetime
Session IP reauthentication retains its existing abort controller and request identity
Timers, animation frames, observers and SSE callbacks are cancelled or generation-checked
Clipboard and archive/file waits cannot publish into a destroyed page
Backup object URLs are revoked synchronously after download dispatch
browser_cache_contract: Persisted pagehide/pageshow retain the same mounted owner, accepted selection and single stream; real unload and explicit remount destroy effects.
